question: By how much did the first charge capacity of the NMC622 recovered from cathode scraps fall short of the baseline's?
rendered:
Document title: Sustainable recycling of cathode scraps via Cyrene-based separation

Page 5 of this document has the relevant information:

"The first charge capacities for the baseline and recovered NMC622 were 205.6 and 194.0 mAh/g, respectively."

To find the difference, subtract the recovered NMC622's capacity from the baseline's: 
205.6 mAh/g - 194.0 mAh/g = 11.6 mAh/g

This is the amount by which the first charge capacity of the NMC622 recovered from cathode scraps fell short of the baseline's.
